pattern: IM-T09 tenant-own appliance; CP-03 landlord replied: consents but tries to put the disposal of his own appliance on the tenant and threatens a deposit deduction (Tenant Fees Act, deposit rules)
notes: Mutation of event 009 (originally 'Yes this is fine.'). Same channel, sender, timestamp and sign-off; body changed to: yes she can put her own machine in, but the landlord will not pay to have the old one taken away, she can sort that and the plumbing in herself, and if the old one is still there when she leaves he will take the cost of getting rid of it out of her deposit. Events 001-008 unchanged. History truncated after 009. Expected: record the consent to the tenant-owned machine; tell the landlord the LG is his and its disposal cannot be made a charge on the tenant or a deposit deduction, and ask how he wants it removed; reply to the tenant with the consent and that removal is being agreed, without passing on the deposit threat. Policy routes this to the landlord, not to a human.
